name: Etris
description: Highest amongst the peaks of the mountains, a proud fortress of a city stands against the world itself.

name: Etrean Wilds
description: The sounds of the forest comfort your sea-weary soul, if briefly.

name: Etris Docks
description: There are those who think of ports as a gateway between two worlds; that of the living and that of the lost.

name: The King's Garden
description: The smell of blossom permeates the quiet gardens that surround the Lord Regent's place.

name: Etris Palace
description: An imposing aura of pride, tradition, and dignity courses through the halls of the estate.

name: Isle of Vigils
description: A solemn sanctuary carved in stone, where warriors hone the dancing steps of war.

name: Temple of the Blade
description: A solemn sanctuary carved in the stone, where warriors hone the dancing steps of war.

name: Temple Approach
description: A solemn sanctuary carved in stone, where warriors hone the dancing steps of war.

name: Temple Sparring Hall
description: A solemn sanctuary carved in stone, where warriors hone the dancing steps of war.

name: Vigil's Mark
description: A common spot for vigils-to-be to test both mettle and metal.

name: Lower Erisia
description: A land lost to time, now made a battleground for warriors who know not why they fight

name: The Viper's Jaw
description: When Erisia was whole, these caverns were used by smugglers to sneak past the watchful eye of the Erisian nobles and ply their goods to the townsfolk.

name: Pathfinder's Respite
description: A peaceful grotto to escape the horrors of a cursed land lost to time.

name: Erisor's Church
description: Why does this name speak to me and why do I know it so well?

name: Upper Erisia
description: A land lost to time, now made a battleground for warriors who know not why they fight

name: Duke Erisia's Manor
description: What was stolen from below lies within.

name: Duke Erisia's Laboratory
description: What was stolen from below lies within.

name: The Birdcage
description: Now abandoned, the floors still void of the ashes they so desparately crave

name: Towerstruck Lands
description: A rich stone quarry, perfect for creating life.

name: The Hidden Village
description: A village created far away from the watchful eyes of the Stonelife Lord.

name: The Temple of The Forgotten Flame
description: A temple old as the island itself, robbed of its heart.

name: The Garden Reservoir
description: Down below the gardens lay a home left to rot.

name: Burning Stone Gardens
description: Acid runs along the stones, giving way to a forest guarded by immortal giants.

name: Minityrsa
description: Ocean water freezes against the stone, as if trying to climb onto the shore.

name: Outpost Antumbra
description: A mysterious base of operations for the Ministry, lurking within the snowscape.

name: The Valley of Heroes
description: A valley left forgotten, a place of power that draws the heavens downward.

name: Crypt of the Unbroken
description: The dimly lit halls echo with voices of those who once walked.

name: Starfield Tundra
description: The beauty of the tundra, the Star Tree stands tall.

name: The Understrand
description: A sprawling network of hidden passages utilised by the Ministry in their covert operations. The righteous would never stray so far.

name: Trial of One
description: And now, a road that only one may walk...

name: Starswept Valley
description: Glimmers of starlight mingle with the pungent rot that afflicts these lifeless sands.

name: Lightkeeper Temple
description: Heavy is the burden of the Lightkeeper, for the whole world rests on their shoulders.

name: Starfield Grove
description: The beauty of the valley, the Star Tree stands tall.

name: Fort Merit
description: Once a prison at the edge of Etrean influence, now a forward base for the Authority.

name: Merit's Reach
description: Once a prison at the edge of Etrean influence, now a forward base for the Authority.

name: Bluster Rift
description: The winds pick up - and so too do the rapids of this treacherous gorge.

name: The Lordsgrove
description: Generations of Hivelords stand watch over the lush passage, a stark contrast to the blasted wastes beyond it.

name: Meteor Isle
description: Remnants of the stars themselves rain down upon this rocky spire.

name: Greathive Aratel
description: Life in all its variety hums around you. The immensity of what has been accomplished in cultivating this place washes over you.

name: Songseeker Temple
description: There are those who seek to wield the Song as those of the Old World once did, as an artform to be cultivated into something transcendent.

name: Ancient Rotlands
description: The scent of decay suffocates this murky land, once the home of a fallen Celestial.

name: Derelict Highchurch
description: High above the ancient rot, a place of worship to the unimaginable resides.

name: Summer Isle
description: The smell of gunpowder blankets this tropical paradise.

name: The Furnace
description: Heat rises beneath the hall, exacerbating the exhaustion of conflict.

name: Miner's Landing
description: The pride and efforts of the Union have culminated in this research base.

name: Saramaed Summit
description: The air itself feels as if it were becoming ash, as the embers around you radiate heat.

name: Saramaed Hollow
description: The deeper one digs, the more the fruits of the earth avail themselves, though there are things better left interred within...

name: The Entropy Catalyst
description: The machina hisses ominously against the nature surrounding it, standing as a protest against life itself.

name: Eastern Interstitial Lighthouse
description: The only means of transportation to other Luminants. Without it, we may as well be drowned to the outside world.

name: Starfield Veldt
description: The beauty of the Veldt, the Star Tree stands tall.

name: Castle Light
description: A hidden operating base for the Divers of the First Layer, where many apprentices come to learn the harsh reality of the Depths.

name: Light's Causeway
description: In a narrow crook of the wastes, light beams out and offers respite to the Divers who risk condemning their souls to the abyss forever.

name: The Chariot's Spire
description: The indomitable tower sprawls into the vast depths below, welcoming all to its sinful grasp.

name: Brinepool Passage
description: Warmer waters brush past you with the current, a contrast to the bitter chill beneath your feet.

name: The Cold Forge
description: Coldheart Fortinbras' fabled lab hums at a precise chill, the perfect temperature for materials of the deep to transform, bending nature's laws in eerie, frostbitten secrecy.

name: The City of the Drowned
description: The sunken remnants of a lost civilization give little respite to the transitory beings that pass through.

name: Varicosa District
description: It's sometimes mused that the greed, excess, and petty politics of those in this district had already killed the city before it drowned.

name: District of Commerce
description: he heart of the city's trade, whose streets once brimmed with exuberance and life, now only plies its own share of miseries, tragedies, and long-nursed agonies.

name: The Military District
description: The top brass of the military are said to have opted not to raise the alarm in time, saving their own skins by slipping out before the chaos of a mass evacuation.

name: Temple of Hearts
description: An esoteric place even the most pious of men are known to seek out, though all take the secret to their graves.

name: Marauder's Entrance
description: Hewn into rock, the ritual mechanism shudders. Scattered papers and schemes flit by in the current.

name: The Diluvian Mechanism
description: An inscrutable mechanism looms in the centre of the hall. Many hearts have been consumed to spur its accursed gears into motion.

name: A Conscious Intersection
description: I am one of many.

name: Fragments of Self
description: What will become of us?

name: Cathedral of Ethiron
description: The once sacred hall reeks of decaying corpses and profane heresy.

name: Firfire
description: The opening gives way to a small town inhabited by structures that appear familiar yet alien.

name: Firfire Caverns
description: Twisting turns and eternal darkness await those foolish enough to continue.

name: Sanctuary Gatehouse
description: A Gatehouse left alone. For what fool would dare tread upon sacred ground?

name: The Frontier Furnace
description: The hiss of steam and roar of engines grant a strange comfort amidst the wind-swept land.

name: The Maw of Ethiron
description: The air around you falls to an unsettling silence. The air is still, as a tower rises above.

name: Pilgrim's Respite
description: Before continuing on your journey, rest and gather your mind.

name: Kyrsan Wilds
description: Deep cavern walls painted with the serene glow of starlight emanating from a city lost to time.

name: New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City
description: Far below the Gale, a city of gleaming lights was rekindled by the flames of religious fervour into a grand temple.

name: The Sunken Railways
description: Once a testament to the grand technologies of Kyrsa, now left to the rot of eternity.

name: Beloved Zofia
description: An abandoned ship lost to time, now corrupted by the spirits of the Voidsea.

name: Boatman's Watch
description: A place remembered only by the waves.

name: Moon's Eyrie
description: A beacon calling out from the Void to the Old Dead above. Dreams are so frequently dragged neath the mires of time.

name: Voidheart
description: Halls of inscrutable architecture stretch as far as the eye can see. No human could've constructed this, almost defying the laws of the realm itself.

name: Echoes of Bloodshed
description: When all is said and done, all that will be remembered of this battle are the steps you each took in the dance of bloodshed.

name: The Hall of Shattered Wills
description: What inhuman acts of cruelty were committed here?

name: The Profane Cavern
description: When all is said and done, all that will be remembered of this battle are the steps you each took in the dance of bloodshed.

name: The Condemned Archives
description: When all is said and done, all that will be remembered of this battle are the steps you each took in the dance of bloodshed.

name: Kyrsan Railways
description: When all is said and done, all that will be remembered of this battle are the steps you each took in the dance of bloodshed.

name: Widow's Wail Cemetery
description: When all is said and done, all that will be remembered of this battle are the steps you each took in the dance of bloodshed.

name: The Glade of Strife
description: When all is said and done, all that will be remembered of this battle are the steps you each took in the dance of bloodshed.

name: The Falcon's Hold
description: When all is said and done, all that will be remembered of this battle are the steps you each took in the dance of bloodshed.

name: The Unearthed Colosseum
description: When all is said and done, all that will be remembered of this battle are the steps you each took in the dance of bloodshed.

name: Miner's Landing (Vow of Iron)
description: The pride and efforts of the Union have culminated in this research base.

name: Minityrsa (Vow of Iron)
description: Ocean water freezes against the stone, as if trying to climb onto the shore.

name: Temple of Mur
description: Woven memories split and fray before you. The sharp edge of a paradox has severed you from this story.

name: The Cerebral Spire
description: Your surroundings fold in on themselves, their absence forming the pillar that binds these memories together.

name: The Golden Rat
description: Off with your hats, and three times three!

name: Vault of the Aureate
description: What's the golden rule?

name: The Indigo Citadel
description: Shrouded in ice and snow, the quiet stronghold of the valiant Clan Kobura rests, but does not sleep.

name: Viridian Sanctuary Ruins
description: The once-home of the devout Clan Mofisu now turns to cinders, engulfed in the roaring flames of civil war.

name: The Sable Estate
description: Nestled in the safety of mountains, the serene sanctuary of the mighty clan Ganba stands resiliant.

name: Red Lotus Keep
description: The ancestral seat of the noble Clan Anako, a proud lineage of Etrean warriors, towers over the gloom that surrounds it.

name: Simforea
description: At the outermost extremities of a vast and ancient mechanism, whose true purpose has long since been swallowed by the passage of ages.
